page_title: MON 3-3 KOL | B. Monchengladbach v FC Koln 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Felix Zwayer is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

90+6' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Good work from B. Monchengladbach as they win a corner.
90+4' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' What a chance that is! Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
90' Corner kick. FC Koln will have an opportunity.

90' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to FC Koln.
89' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
87' The referee allows time for a substitution. Sargis Adamyan will be replaced by Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln).
87' Rocco Reitz passes to Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.
85' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
85' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from B. Monchengladbach was in an offside position.
84' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
83' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) for his blatant foul.
83' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
81' Moritz Nicolas comes off his line to intercept the corner from Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln).
81' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
79' 3 - 3 Goal! A great through ball by Denis Huseinbasic sets up Damion Downs (1. FC Koln) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom right corner. 3:3.
77' Two players stand over the free kick. Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
76' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. FC Koln win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
75' Here is a change. Florian Kainz is going off and Timo Schultz gives the last tactical orders to Davie Selke (1. FC Koln).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Damion Downs (1. FC Koln) comes onto the pitch for Faride Alidou.
75' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Felix Zwayer signals that there was no infringement and the goal stands! The B. Monchengladbach players celebrate.
75' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an infringement in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The B. Monchengladbach players aren’t happy.
73' 3 - 2 Goal! Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top left corner. He makes it 3:2.
73' The attendance is 54042.
73' The ball goes behind for a corner. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maximilian Wober leaves the pitch and Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.

71' 2 - 2 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Stefan Lainer is pounced on by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach). His close-range header flashes past Marvin Schwabe and into the left of the goal. 2:2.
70' Gerardo Seoane prepares a substitution. Nathan Ngoumou is replaced by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach).
70' Substitution. Manu Kone makes way for Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).

69' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
69' The corner from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is hurriedly cleared.

69' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the top right corner, but Marvin Schwabe shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. The ball is out of play and B. Monchengladbach manage to earn a corner.
68' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) tries to find Faride Alidou, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
65' That's the end of the game for Linton Maina, who is replaced by Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln).

64' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Florian Kainz flights the free kick into the box, where Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) peels off his marker and heads it straight into the bottom left corner from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:2.
63' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle after Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick is awarded to FC Koln.
62' That will be all from Luca Netz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach).
59' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) heads on.
59' The corner from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared away by the defence.
58' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. B. Monchengladbach will take a corner kick.
53' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the right post. Unlucky!
51' Franck Honorat flicks on the near post corner to Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) at the back post, but he somehow heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
51' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

50' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. B. Monchengladbach force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
49' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) tries to find Rasmus Carstensen, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
47' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
47' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) is booked for saying more than Felix Zwayer was willing to tolerate.
46' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+1' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Moritz Nicolas, who pulls off a stunning save!
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' An attempted cross from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is cleared.
43' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) rises high to meet a nice lofted pass inside the penalty area, but directs his header to one of his teammates who unintentionally deflects away.
41' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision. Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
40' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
39' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

36' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach will have a chance to score from a corner.
35' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

35' He should have scored! Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.

32' 1 - 1 Goal! Florian Neuhaus slips a clever pass through to Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
31' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
30' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
30' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Felix Zwayer signals.
29' The total number of attempts is 3:4. The current number of shots on goal is 1:2.
24' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Moritz Nicolas scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
24' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) brings his opponent down. Felix Zwayer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to FC Koln in a dangerous position.
22' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

21' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Moritz Nicolas.
19' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Sargis Adamyan.
17' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) sends a long ball forward to Faride Alidou, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach will have a throw-in.
14' Felix Zwayer interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln).
13' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Marvin Schwabe scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
10' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

10' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

9' What a sweet touch by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) as he runs onto a pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive to the left side of the net. The keeper makes a superb save and pushes the ball against the post. Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) blows a clear opportunity! He sends a rebound from close range narrowly wide of the left post.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Moritz Nicolas makes a huge mistake and Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 0:1.
6' FC Koln players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
2' One of the players from FC Koln times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The match has just started.
B. Monchengladbach will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Felix Zwayer.
